t: A machine that generates $(6)water$() from surrounding sourceblocks.$(br2)When adjacent to at least $(6)2 water source blocks$(), it will start working.$(br)Adding additional source blocks and supplying $(6)1000()RF per operation, will make the machine significally faster.
一台利用周围源水方块生成 $(6)水$() 的机器。$(br2)当相邻至少 $(6)2 个水源方块$() 时，它就会开始工作。$(br)添加更多源水方块并为每次操作提供 $(6)1000()RF，可大幅提升机器速度。
